# Modliq — No-Code Manufacturing Intelligence and ML Platform

Modliq is a no-code manufacturing intelligence and machine learning platform by Qeltrava AI, built in Tamil Nadu, India.

Website: https://modliq-io.vercel.app/
Parent company: Qeltrava AI
Parent website: https://qeltravaai.vercel.app/en
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/qeltravai/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/qeltravaai

Positioning Statement:
"Analyze what happened. Optimize what happens next. Prove it with a Quality Passport."

Core Concept:
Modliq combines no-code analytics and no-code machine learning for manufacturing teams.
It automates the repetitive workflows normally done by data analysts and ML engineers—without requiring a data analyst, data scientist, or ML engineer to get started.

Role Integration:
1. Data Analyst Mode (Analyze what happened):
   - Dataset health checks, EDA Studio, natural language data queries (Ask Your Factory Data), Smart Charts, statistical process control (SPC), Cp/Cpk process capability, OEE, downtime Pareto, supplier lot risk, and executive insight narratives.
2. ML Engineer Mode (Optimize what happens next):
   - Natural language goal parsing, feature validation, AutoML benchmarking leaderboard (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, Extra Trees, Linear), constrained safe setpoint optimization, feature engineering suggestions, model trust monitoring, and retraining recommendations.
3. The Evidence Layer (Prove it with a Quality Passport):
   - Combines historical analysis, ML optimization, trial SOPs, CAPA actions, and MLOps model lineage into a 1-click buyer-ready audit document.

Important Security & Execution Rules:
- Modliq does NOT execute arbitrary user code or arbitrary SQL. Natural language questions are converted into safe, deterministic query plans.
- Data cleaning actions are advisory by default and create a versioned Dataset Version 2 without mutating raw datasets.
- Model trust monitoring flags distribution drift, but requires explicit user confirmation before model retraining.

Primary Audience:
- Manufacturing companies (Chemicals, Automotive, Pharma, Food, Packaging, Textiles, Plastics, General Engineering)
- Indian MSME and SME manufacturers
- Plant heads, Quality heads, Process engineers, Operations heads, Supplier Quality engineers, and Lean Kaizen teams.
